label: The selected p supplies a distinct actual own-being cause for every participant
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. For each x bearing the existing q44 participation predicate, the selected p is distinct from x, actual as to esse, its own subsistent being (the existing primitive OwnBeing), and a cause of x in the same esse respect. This gives one specified essential cause per participant, not that every possible essential cause is p, and no GOD_4 identification.
